stored_prev_order_id.meaning: stored prevOrderId of the non-head order read from storage
stored_prev_order_id.checkpoint: before cancel/match of the non-head order

non_head_order_cancelled_or_matched.meaning: a non-head order is cancelled or matched

order_addressable_via_chain.meaning: the order is addressable via the limit's headOrder/tailOrder chain
order_addressable_via_chain.checkpoint: after cancel/match of the non-head order

open_interest_reflects_reachable_only.meaning: open-interest counters reflect reachable orders only (no orphaned order still counted)
open_interest_reflects_reachable_only.checkpoint: after cancel/match of the non-head order

open_interest_misaccounted.meaning: open-interest is inflated or deflated relative to reachable orders, causing wrong fee accrual and possible withdrawal failures
open_interest_misaccounted.checkpoint: after cancel/match of the non-head order

assumptions: The non-head order is part of a price level whose back-link was corrupted by the memory-copy append described in the report.
Open-interest counters are the numBids/Asks and *_OpenInterest counters named in the report.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric magnitudes or a formula for the open-interest inflation/deflation, so the misaccounting is represented as a grounded Boolean relation rather than a numeric delta.

limitations: The exact numeric amount of open-interest inflation/deflation and the fee-accrual/withdrawal-failure consequences are not formalized; only the misaccounting relation is captured.
Whether the final orphaned order deletion occurs via expiry or user cancel is conditional and not fixed.
